_meta.name: lasso
_meta.description: Lasso regression: REG_OLS with penalty l1 and alpha 500 (coordinate descent with soft-thresholding on the streaming Gram); alpha is on the scale of the squared-error loss, so it needs to be large here, and at 500 it sets label's coefficient to exactly 0 and keeps price, a selected model. A penalty that selects predictors from the data has no analytical standard errors: they, the p-values and the intervals are null with advisory PULSE_ADVISORY_PENALIZED_INFERENCE_UNDEFINED; set resample bootstrap or jackknife for replicate ones. Streamable.
